title: quanda: An Interpretability Toolkit for Training Data Attribution Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2410.07158v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training data attribution (TDA) methods estimate the influence of individual training samples on a model's predictions, offering a principled lens for interpreting neural networks. Despite rapid methodological progress, TDA evaluation remains scattered across papers and rarely reproducible, making fair comparison between methods challenging. We introduce quanda, a Python toolkit that standardizes TDA evaluation. quanda features a comprehensive collection of evaluation metrics and ready-to-use benchmarks spanning image classification, text classification, and language modeling, alongside a uniform interface for integrating diverse TDA implementations. We showcase quanda through a comparative study of existing TDA methods and find that no approach excels uniformly across metrics, with clear trade-offs between ground-truth faithfulness and downstream task performance. translated_title: quanda：一个用于训练数据归因评估的可解释性工具包
translated_abstract: 训练数据归因（TDA）方法通过估计单个训练样本对模型预测的影响，为解释神经网络提供了一个有原则的视角。尽管方法研究进展迅速，但TDA的评估仍然分散于各篇论文之中且很少可复现，这使得方法之间的公平比较极具挑战性。我们推出了quanda，一个用于标准化TDA评估的Python工具包。quanda提供了全面的评估指标集合，以及覆盖图像分类、文本分类和语言建模的即用型基准，并为集成多种不同的TDA实现提供了统一的接口。我们通过对现有TDA方法的比较研究展示了quanda的功能，发现没有任何一种方法能够在所有指标上均表现出色，在真实标签忠实度与下游任务性能之间存在明显的权衡。通过整合围绕TDA的工具生态，quanda为社区提供了……
tldr: quanda是一个标准化训练数据归因（TDA）评估的Python工具包，提供了全面的评估指标和覆盖图像分类、文本分类及语言建模的即用型基准，并通过大规模比较研究揭示了现有TDA方法在不同指标之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: quanda is a Python toolkit that standardizes training data attribution (TDA) evaluation with comprehensive metrics and ready-to-use benchmarks across image classification, text classification, and language modeling, revealing clear trade-offs among existing TDA methods across evaluation metrics.
